name: @vssaros/dsh-workflow
description: VsSaros workflow module for DeepSeek Harness — read-only slice: lists ~/.vssaros/workflows/<id>/workflow.json, renders the node graph as a server-side SVG canvas, exposes workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_engine_status tools, and self-proves the Host's worker_threads capability (the prerequisite for migrating the engine). Engine migration itself is NOT done. Sideview is a compact list (search / filter chips / sort / collapsible self-diagnostics); the canvas moved into a collapsed section at the bottom so the list owns the first screen (doc/workflow-sideview-refactor-mockup.html option A).
